page.overview:
Who is Sagoro Autem's grandfather?

The grandfather of the Human male Sagoro Autem was a member of the Galactic Republic's Senate Guard, protecting the Republic's legislators. Duty, honor, and loyalty to the Republic were deeply ingrained in his family. His son and grandson would later follow in his footsteps.
